opening.argument: The presentation is a holiday vision-care promotion set in an eyewear setting, with speakers encouraging viewers to book an eye exam by phone or link. The description directly connects that booking to a reward: “Call 905.893.8999 or click http://www.kleinburgvisioncentre.com/ to book your eye exam & get a FREE Starbucks gift card.” The spoken message likewise says viewers can “book an eye exam” and receive a “$25 Starbucks gift card.” The available evidence describes no deceptive conduct, payment or credential demands, fulfillment issue, or outcome. The destination remains unverified, but the observable record supports an ordinary reward, loyalty, or promotional offer rather than establishing wrongdoing.
